scoring_justification: Band gaps are recomputed from submitted band structure files (T1). Dielectric constants and absorption edge are compared to paper values with tolerances (T0 result-level). Polaron mobility is thresholded against paper-reported enhancement (T0). Overall the strongest feasible tier is recompute.

outputs.description: Band structure of N-doped BiVO4 with excess O vacancies (spin-polarized).
High-frequency and static dielectric constants for pristine and N-doped BiVO4.
Small polaron properties and computed mobility enhancement.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are re-derivable from first-principles calculations. The band structure files allow recomputation of band gaps; dielectric constants and polaron quantities are directly compared to hidden paper values. The optical absorption redshift is a result-level comparison.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for band gaps, dielectric constants, polaron mobility enhancement, and absorption redshift, sourced from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Nature Communications 6:8769 (2015), sections Results, Methods, and Supplementary Information.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported DFT results: pristine bandgap 2.25 eV; dielectric constants ε∞=6.9, ε₀=52; N-doped ε∞=6.2, ε₀=27; polaron mobility enhancement ~25%; absorption redshift ~0.3 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These numbers are the exact values published in the paper and are used as hidden reference targets; they are not fabricated.
